target_customer: Young anonymous posters; a planned workplace spin-off aimed at employees
problem: People wanted to post gossip and secrets anonymously and see what their friend groups posted.
business_model: advertising on an anonymous community, none confirmed

founders.name: Paul McKellar
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder; his current profile mentions later work in social media and payments at Square, which is after this company and not used as a prior employer.

technical_complexity.rationale: An anonymous posting site with friend group updates was simple CRUD, though handling 600 posts a day needed basic moderation.

defensibility.rationale: Anonymous posting had no barrier to copying; value rested only on community size.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes an incumbent response.

market_need_then: The YC description reports over 600 posts a day, mostly from women, which suggests organic demand for anonymous gossip, but only as stated in a directory blurb.

branding.domain_note: socialmoth.com did not resolve in the session, so its status is unknown.

identity.mascot_or_character: moth in the name, no confirmed mascot

branding.community_and_virality: YC blurb says the community made over 600 posts per day.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive name and an active posting community per the YC blurb, but no press or lasting brand found.

pivots.why: The YC blurb says a new spin was planned; it does not say whether it launched.

outcome_analysis: Socialmoth was a two person anonymous gossip community in the Winter 2007 batch that claimed 600 posts a day and planned a workplace spin-off called Disenchat. It is now inactive. No shutdown cause, funding or acquisition appears in any source found, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are assigned.
notes: Company site socialmoth.com failed DNS resolution in the session (network limits or dead site). Competitor search found only later Juicy Campus era coverage, nothing dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Funding search returned unrelated companies. The Disenchat outcome is unknown.
